_about: Map backgrounds (render/background.js): one area per map, its own sky, ground and distant-scenery textures and how the area wraps them. Built by build-map-backgrounds.py, which carries the notes.

maps.name: Jurassic Frontier
maps.note: a00 is the base camp (tent cloth, tent sounds); a06 is a hunting area with a panorama sky.

maps.name: Misty Peaks
maps.note: jimen3 rather than the most-used jimen2, whose large roots make the tiling plain on a background disc.

maps.name: Marshlands
maps.note: No Marshlands area names a sky texture; the misty forest panorama enkei00, a full ring on the area, is its sky.

maps.name: Slayground
maps.note: Map 10's own arena (a01) references no sky texture at all; its a00 is the Arena's shared area, whose m09a00d textures it loads.

maps.name: Primal Forest
maps.note: jimen09 rather than the most-used jimen10, a clover overlay with holes that is not a base ground.

maps.name: Forlorn Arena
maps.note: kumo2 is the sea of clouds below the arena (-69 to -3 degrees); kumo1 is the sky, and the enkei cloud strip (-8 to 1 degrees) is the scenery.

maps.name: Polar Field
maps.note: The sky texture is plain white and the dome's vertex colours carry the sky (the tint); a01's sky takes no vertex colour, so a00. kouri01 (ice) is the most-used ground near the origin.
